# NeuromorphicGraphAnomalyDetection

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework that maps graph data onto spiking neural networks to detect anomalous patterns using spike-based temporal coding and STDP learning. Provides a low-power, event-driven solution for detecting intrusions or faults in network graphs, directly applicable to in-network neuromorphic processing.
